name: tooling
description: Skills for effective use of developer tooling. Sister plugin to house-style and house-rules.

interface.longDescription: Skills (and Claude Code hooks) for getting the most out of developer tooling: structural code search and rewriting with ast-grep, markdown knowledge-base search with qmd, and uv/uvx for Python execution and package management.
defaultPrompt: Search this codebase structurally with ast-grep.
Run this Python with uv instead of pip and venv.
Search my markdown notes for relevant context.
